component.name: PlayPets
component.summary: A yard where your pets talk to each other
ペットたちがおしゃべりし合う庭
宠物们互相聊天的乐园

description.p: PlayPets is an open-source desktop pet app with four starter friends and four places to spend time together. Import compatible Codex pet files or create a background of your own. Time, weather and seasons bring the yard to life.

ul.li: Each friend talks through its own AI: a Claude Code or Codex subscription, Ollama, or an OpenAI-compatible server.
Friends answer in turn in one conversation and keep chatting among themselves.
Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and MCP tools) show their work as a friend's poses.
Play hide and seek, a parade or tag, or send friends out to roam the desktop.
Dig for finds, grow flowers and trees, and fish and catch bugs for the album, with no AI needed.
Friends and settings are saved on your computer. AI conversations go to the provider you connect.

description.p: PlayPets is not affiliated with OpenAI. Codex is a trademark of OpenAI.

description.p: Grok moved into the yard: a friend keeps Grok Build company while it codes, and friends can chat through Grok.

ul.li: A friend reacts while Grok Build thinks, uses a tool, waits for you and finishes.
Friends can chat through Grok with an xAI API key, kept in your system's secure storage.
Grok Build also runs Claude Code and Cursor hooks; its work now shows only on its own friend.
The seed count stays inside the Plant a seed tile when the tile is narrow.
